fields.name: global_magic
fields.meaning: Marks the save memory as formatted: always 0x007B. Anything else and the game wipes and re-formats the memory at power-on.
fields.evidence: code d000:d04f (format), d000:cfe4-d074 (check at boot); diff blank vs freshly booted memory

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum over 0x0004-0x5533 (all four save files). Same value is kept twice (also at 0x5544); both copies must match each other and the sum, or the game re-formats.
fields.evidence: recomputed on every save image (all match); code d000:d10a, d000:cae3, d000:d076-d09a

fields.name: b_funds
fields.meaning: In-battle save: the player's money. Capped at 9,999,999. Shown in the file list.
fields.evidence: code f000:8d32 (add, capped 0x98967F), d000:676c (spend), d000:d3d9 (file list display); value 0 on the first map

fields.name: b_total_earned
fields.meaning: In-battle save: total money earned over the game (map earnings are added when a map ends). Capped at 9,999,999.

fields.name: b_funds_at_map_start
fields.meaning: In-battle save: money held when the current map began, used to compute the map's earnings.

fields.name: b_stage
fields.meaning: In-battle save: number of the map / scenario now being played.
fields.evidence: code b000:c031; f000:b44b and f000:d6e6 swap it with the scenario number (0x008e)

fields.name: b_stage_flags
fields.meaning: In-battle save: map state word; the game sets bit 0x0400 in it when resuming.
fields.evidence: code b000:c034, d000:caf2 (or 0x400 on load); value 0x1000 in the natural save

fields.name: b_turn
fields.meaning: In-battle save: turn number on the current map (counts from 0).
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves one turn apart (0->1); code f000:d555 (incremented together with 0x006c)

fields.name: b_unknown_08f2
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state block (not identified).

fields.name: b_cursor_y
fields.meaning: In-battle save: map cursor row.
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves with the cursor moved (0x14->0x13); main unit row in unit table equals it

fields.name: b_cursor_x
fields.meaning: In-battle save: map cursor column.
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves with the cursor moved (0x1d->0x20)

fields.name: b_unknown_08af
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state values (not identified).

fields.name: b_unknown_0268
fields.meaning: In-battle save: two words, values 0x16 and 0x10 (not identified).

fields.name: b_view_y
fields.meaning: In-battle save: map view (scroll) row.
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves with the cursor moved (4->3 past the screen edge)

fields.name: b_view_x
fields.meaning: In-battle save: map view (scroll) column.
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves with the cursor moved (7->10)

fields.name: b_unknown_013c_a
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state values (not identified).

fields.name: b_packed_29d1
fields.meaning: In-battle save: low 4 bits of the packed byte shared with 0x396b.
fields.evidence: code b000:c0c6 (saved OR-ed with 0x396b), d000:caf2 (loaded back masked with 0x0F)

fields.name: b_packed_396b
fields.meaning: In-battle save: high 4 bits of the packed byte shared with 0x29d1.
fields.evidence: code b000:c0c6 (saved OR-ed with 0x29d1), d000:caf2 (loaded back masked with 0xF0)

fields.name: b_unknown_013c_b
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state values (not identified).

fields.name: b_unknown_015f
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state block (not identified).

fields.name: b_total_turns
fields.meaning: In-battle save: total turns played over the whole game.
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves one turn apart (0->1); code f000:d55a

fields.name: b_unknown_0912
fields.meaning: In-battle save: block also kept in normal saves (not identified; all zeros in the natural save).

fields.name: b_scenario
fields.meaning: In-battle save: scenario number (kept in normal saves too).

fields.name: b_map_units
fields.meaning: In-battle save: the units on the battle map, 42 records of 62 bytes (players and enemies; 13 used in the natural save).
fields.evidence: code b000:c2ae-c2c3 (copy loop 0x2a x 0x3e); diff one turn apart

fields.name: b_map_pilots
fields.meaning: In-battle save: pilot state for the map, 72 records of 33 bytes.

fields.name: b_roster_a
fields.meaning: Persistent roster table, 70 records of 20 bytes (likely the robot list).
fields.evidence: code d000:c9ce-c9e1 (copy loop 0x46 x 0x14); same block in normal saves

fields.name: b_roster_b
fields.meaning: Persistent roster table, 70 records of 35 bytes (likely the pilot list).
fields.evidence: code d000:ca05-ca18 (copy loop 0x46 x 0x23); same block in normal saves

fields.name: b_map_data
fields.meaning: In-battle save only: 557 bytes of map state read one byte at a time through a lookup routine.
fields.evidence: code d000:ca21-ca4e (only when saving the in-battle file)

fields.name: b_unknown_f5a1
fields.meaning: 28 bytes read through a lookup routine (not identified); kept in normal saves too. Refreshed from RAM 0x394c at map end.

fields.name: b_mech_name
fields.meaning: Name of the hero's robot (default ヤルダバオト).
fields.evidence: diff before/after the hero setup screen; copied from the live copy at 0x5c2a by d000:caa7

fields.name: b_hero_name
fields.meaning: Hero's full name (default フォルカ=アルバーク). Katakana byte = 0x3D + gojuon index; 0xF0 = voiced mark on the next kana, 0xBD = ー, 0xC0 = '='.
fields.evidence: diff before/after the hero setup screen; decoding checked against the default names

fields.name: b_hero_nickname
fields.meaning: Hero's nickname (default フォルカ).
fields.evidence: diff before/after the hero setup screen

fields.name: b_unknown_0963
fields.meaning: Three single bytes kept in normal saves too (not identified).

fields.name: b_unknown_2371
fields.meaning: In-battle save: battle state block (mostly 0xFF lists; not identified).

fields.name: b_byte_3944
fields.meaning: In-battle save: byte copied from RAM 0x3944 (not identified).

fields.meaning: In-battle save: byte copied from RAM 0x39a8 (not identified).

fields.name: b_bytes_0251
fields.meaning: In-battle save: three bytes copied from RAM 0x0251-0x0253 (not identified).

fields.name: b_unknown_394c
fields.meaning: In-battle save: 27 bytes (not identified). The last 11 bytes fall outside the file checksum.

fields.name: b_magic
fields.meaning: In-battle save present: 0x007B; 0xFFFF = no in-battle save.
fields.evidence: code d000:cace (write), d000:d0d3 (compared with 0x0000); blank format writes 0xFFFF

fields.name: b_checksum
fields.meaning: In-battle save checksum: 16-bit sum of the words at 0x0004-0x2643.
fields.evidence: recomputed on every image holding a battle save; code d000:d10a, d000:cabf, d000:d0f1
